notes: 2026-10-04 replacement for the bird-carrying Japanese-forest distant variants: cut @1300s of the delicate-rainforest master (the same recording as rain-1/rain-2), lowpass 2.8kHz (distance), stereo, 48 kHz, loudnorm I=-20 LUFS TP=-1.0 LRA=11 (the 2026-07-01 recipe). Screened before cutting: 0 tonal events 2.5-9 kHz, 0 sustained calls 400-2500 Hz, 0 speech segments (faster-whisper VAD) across the 480 s window. Seamless-looped to 409s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless. Encoded as Opus (128k) — see DECISIONS.md 'Ship scene audio as Opus, not MP3'.

processing.loopStartRationale: start chosen so the 6s before the wrap and the 6s after it sit at the same level at P=409s; trimming from 0 put a fade-in against a settled tail
